cohort: 112 women requiring labor induction were randomly assigned to two groups of 56 each, one receiving vaginal misoprostol and the other receiving intracervical dinoprostone E2 gel, with an additional 56 women experiencing spontaneous labor serving as a control group.
finding: Misoprostol resulted in shorter induction to delivery time, higher vaginal delivery rates, and fewer doses required compared to dinoprostone gel, but was associated with a higher incidence of non-reassuring/pathological CTG.
